p.i: recordare: Propter Sionem non tacebo, & propter Ierusalem non quiescam, donec prodeat ut splendor iustitia eius, & salus eius ut lampas ardeat.

main_text.head: INDEX LOCORVM SACRÆ SCRIPTVRÆ, QVÆ obiter explicantur.
main_text.p: Duorum numerorum, qui præfiguntur cotextui, prior caput libri Bibliorum indicat, posterior versum; si unicus sit, versum tantum: trium autem, qui subiunguntur, primus librum notat de Romanæ Ecclesiæ idololatria, secundus caput, ultimus paragraphum. Epist. epistolam ad Anglica Seminaria; Præfat. præfationem in libros de idololatria; Admonit. vero admonitionem ad lectore designat.
main_text.head: EX VETERE TESTAMENTO.
GENESIS.
main_text.l: 1. 26. Faciamus hominem ad imaginem nostram. 2.3.39.& 44. Item 2.5.8.
27. 21. Ego sum Esau primogenitus tuus: feci quemadmodum edixisti mihi. 1.5.6.
53. Dii Abrahami & Dii Nachoris iudicet inter nos: sed iuravit [?]acob &c. 1.5.2.
main_text.head: EXODVS.

page.notes: The first letter of "Faciamus" is a large decorated F, joined to the word. The mark before "31." is unclear and may be a reference sign; it is copied as printed. "Erúntque": the final letters are faint. "[?]acob": the initial glyph is unclear, possibly I. "Admonit." has a struck or ornamental mark over part of the word. The top italic line is the end of a paragraph from the previous page; "recordare" is the start of that fragment. Numbers in the index are copied as printed, including the punctuation.
